title: A Note under the Door
story:
Clara found a folded note under her apartment door after work. It told her to look in the place where the spare key hides. She lived alone, and that key sat under a loose brick by the stairs. She felt nervous, so she called her neighbour Yusuf, and they went down together. The brick was pulled out a little. Under it were a second note and a small envelope.

The second note said the first one was a test from her brother Andre. He was in the city and wanted to see if she still used their old hiding place. The envelope held forty euros and a ticket for a play that evening. Andre wrote that the money was his share of a gift for their mother. He asked Clara to add her share and buy the gift the next day.

Clara compared the writing with an old postcard from Andre. The letters matched. Yusuf laughed and called it a family game. Clara still moved the key, because a note about a hiding place was not a safe joke. She put the envelope in a drawer and sent Andre a message. At the play he sat beside her and grinned. She thanked him, then told him never to leave a key clue again. Andre promised to send a normal message before the next surprise. Clara kept the ticket in her coat pocket for the evening.
